text:
zoe: Heads-up: detection flagged OIDC tokens minted with the onboarding-federation provider that contained the broad audience claim 'projects/redwood-prod' and elevated role bindings (roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator) for a partner repo. Observed 2026-10-14T11:22:10Z.

secops-bot: [ALERT] oidc-aud-anomaly provider=onboarding-federation count=23 triggered at 2026-10-14T11:22:12Z.

patrick: Quick summary: trust config allowed wildcard audiences and a partner repo was able to request tokens with project-wide audience. We must contain, audit tokens issued in last 72h, and tighten the provider trust to explicit repo audience only.

samir: Containment steps I'll run now: 1) disable onboarding-federation provider immediately (soft disable for 5m to avoid infra outages), 2) list tokens issued in last 72h with that audience, 3) rotate any service-account keys that show suspicious token creation.

infra-oncall: Detection query to enumerate tokens and bindings:
```
# GCP audit log search for OIDC token creation with unusual audience
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"GenerateIdToken\" AND protoPayload.request.audience:\"projects/redwood-prod\" AND timestamp>\"2026-10-11T00:00:00Z\"" --limit 1000
```

infra-oncall: Also checking IAM activity for role grants around that time.

zoe: Blast radius: onboarding pipelines, partner CI runners that use workload identity, and any service accounts that were granted tokenCreator. Likely limited to the partner's repo and a small set of internal onboarding agents.

secops-bot: [TASK] FED-AUDIT-317 created to track token audit, trust-policy patch, and customer outreach.

samir: Found 6 generated tokens with the 'projects/redwood-prod' audience issued by partner-ci@partner.org between 11:10 and 11:20 UTC. Two service accounts were used to exchange those tokens for short-lived credentials. Rotating those SA keys and removing tokenCreator binds now.

patrick: Patching trust policy: require attribute 'repo==redwood/partner-infra' and audience 'signin.partners.redwood.com/partner-infra'. I'll prepare the narrow policy and canary it.

devex: Heads-up SDK/runtime impact: any onboarding flows using the old audience will fail. We'll add guidance and a helper to fetch tokens with the new audience. Target docs + helper within 6h.

legal: If partner tokens were misused, we need to notify that partner and preserve logs. I'll open LEGAL-PRIV-221 and coordinate with CS.

infra-oncall: Quick mitigation applied: disabled federation provider at 11:35 UTC (soft for 5m), observed no failures from internal pipelines. Provider fully disabled at 11:40 UTC.

samir: Rotation notes: removed roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator from the two SAs, rotated any long-lived keys, and enforced workload identity bindings limited to the specific repo.

patrick: Rolling the new trust policy to a canary now. Monitor for GenerateIdToken errors and any service interruptions. Rollback plan ready.

secops-bot: canary deploy: trust-policy v1.2 -> canary at 2026-10-14T12:05:00Z.

infra-oncall: Audit results: no evidence of lateral movement or external egress tied to those tokens. All token exchanges originated from partner CI IP ranges. Partner has been contacted and their CI runner disabled pending rotation.

cs: Drafted partner-facing notice explaining the mis-issue, actions taken, and recommended rotation steps. Holding for legal approval then we'll send.

devex: Will add SDK warning that rejects wildcard audiences and surfaces clear migration steps (code samples for GetIDToken with audience).

zoe: Next actions: 1) finish token audit for 72h window 2) finalize and deploy strict trust policy 3) push DevEx docs + helper 4) notify partner + keep logs for 90 days in case of follow-up.

samir: Audit run complete: 23 tokens total, 2 SAs involved, no suspicious API calls outside expected onboarding flows. Marking incident FED-AUDIT-317 as CONTAINED (partial).

patrick: Postmortem owner: samir. We'll run an org scan for any federated providers using wildcard audiences and add an enforcement rule in 7 days.

zoe: Thanks team. If your service used onboarding-federation and you need help migrating to the new audience, ping @devex or this thread. Closing once partner notice sent and policy enforcement rule created. :shield:
